title: ze_realm_of_shadows
description:
A personal Zombie Escape Map, independently developed for CS2.

Map Chapters (Stages):

CHAPTER I: The Hollow Realm
CHAPTER II: The Devil's Domain
CHAPTER III: The Nether Depths

All three chapters are designed to be difficult, with each chapter becoming harder as the journey progresses. The difficulty is not structured as a simple level-by-level progression; each chapter presents its own challenges, with the later chapters demanding considerably more from the players.

CHAPTER III: It is highly recommended to pay close attention to map chat messages. Important information and instructions may appear there, and overlooking them may have consequences.

The map contains 2 human items, as well as a secret item for Zombies that can be obtained through a hidden secret.

One of the human items, the Scorcher, is especially important during Chapter III. Once obtained, it must remain in human hands throughout the chapter until the required encounter. Do not drop, lose, or abandon it. If the Scorcher is lost and cannot be recovered, the encounter cannot progress and the entire human team will be killed, resulting in a round restart.

Admins are permitted to use Transfer Item to recover the Scorcher if necessary.

CS2Fixes Required!!

The map highly relies on CS2Fixes for its features and functionality.
